justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/FieldAttributeAppender.java:203-244 and found a small composite wrapper that only stores a List<FieldAttributeAppender>, flattens nested Compound/NoOp instances, and delegates apply() to each contained appender.
